prose: Engadget reports Meta quietly launched Waddle World, a Tamagotchi-like AI pet-rearing game, in the Philippines in late September. Meta describes it as a 'daily journal disguised as a pet': you hatch an egg, feed and play with the pet, and write or dictate journal entries that the AI pet answers with a reply and a doodle.

Mini-games - stacking groceries on the pet's head, catching falling stars, spelling words - earn points for food and toys. Engadget reads the cuteness as Meta's strategy to get people using and training its models and agents; the game is Philippines-only for now, on the App Store and Google Play.
highlights: Waddle World: Meta's AI 'daily journal disguised as a pet'
Philippines-only soft launch since late September
AI pet replies to journal entries with doodles
Mini-games fund pet care; 'Tamagotchi meets ChatGPT'
